spans.s: + जीविन् श्येन- + जीविन्, m. one who lives by training hawks, a falconer,

श्येत (probably from श्वि in श्वित्, cf. श्वेत and Zend. श्पि in श्पि + तम, श्पि + ति),
 I. adj., f. ता and श्येनी, White,

श्येन (akin to the last),
 I. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. A hawk, Pañc. 188, 15.
 II. f. नी. A female hawk.
